title: Cider-Grilled Pork Porterhouse
htmlIngredientLines: 4																		pork "porterhouse steaks" or loin chops (each 1 inch thick and 10 to 12 ounces)
4									tablespoons									Asian (dark) sesame oil, walnut oil, or olive oil
2																		strips lemon zest (each about 2 by 1/2 inch; see note)
8																		fresh sage leaves, or 1 teaspoon dried sage
2																		scallions, white parts gently crushed with the side of a cleaver, green parts finely chopped
2																		cloves garlic, peeled and gently crushed with the side of a cleaver
2																		slices fresh ginger (1/4 inch thick), peeled and gently crushed with the side of a cleaver
coarse salt (kosher or sea) and freshly ground black pepper
